scripts.check:frontend: npm run check:comments && npm run check:frontend --prefix frontend
scripts.check:rust: npm run check:comments && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets
scripts.test: cargo nextest run --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --status-level fail --final-status-level fail
scripts.test:launch: cargo nextest run --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --test launch --run-ignored ignored-only --status-level fail --final-status-level fail
